whyChoose.title: Why Choose Our Platform
whyChoose.subtitle: Discover the powerful tools and features designed to streamline your HR processes.
whyChoose.analyticsDesc: Gain insights into workforce trends with our comprehensive dashboard.
whyChoose.integrationDesc: Connect easily with your favorite tools like Slack and Zoom.
whyChoose.securityDesc: Bank-grade encryption keeps your sensitive data protected.
whyChoose.timeDesc: Automated attendance tracking and leave management systems.
whyChoose.teamDesc: Foster a connected culture with built-in communication channels.
whyChoose.aiDesc: Leverage artificial intelligence to screen candidates faster.

process.title: Application Process
process.step1Desc: Upload your resume directly to the opening. Our AI screening gives instant feedback.
process.step2Desc: Our HR team carefully reviews your profile against our requirements.
process.step3Desc: Schedule a meeting with the team to discuss your future at Huma.

workplace.title: Experience the Digital Workplace
workplace.desc: Our internal platform streamlines everything from attendance to analytics. Get a glimpse of the tools you'll use daily.
